title: nan
authors: Ramos G.S.; Pinto M.F.; Andrade F.A.A.; Haddad D.B.
key_contribution: Presents a real-time distributed monocular visual SLAM and RL path optimization framework (ARCog-NET) for multi-UAV swarm mapping in GPS-denied indoor environments.
